item.title: Transitioning to Semi-No-Rules Survival (Effective Nov 10)
item.dc:creator: cbladeOfficial
item.description: Starting November 10, 2026, FiestaSMP is shifting to semi-no-rules. Griefing, stealing, raiding, and PvP are allowed. Cheating, doxxing, slurs, lag machines, and duping remain strictly banned.
item.content:encoded:
Starting tomorrow, November 10, 2026, FiestaSMP is shifting toward a semi-no-rules survival server.

We ran polls in Discord and talked through how we want survival to feel. The server has always had a candid, rough-around-the-edges community, and handling endless claim dispute tickets when people raid each other takes away from what makes vanilla survival fun. So we are opening up the wild:

What is Allowed (Effective Nov 10)

  • Griefing & Base Raiding: Raiding bases, breaking into storage rooms, and taking whatever loot you find is allowed.
  • Stealing & Looting: Unlocked chests, farms, and containers anywhere in the world can be looted.
  • Open PvP: PvP is enabled across the map outside of spawn docks. Watch your back.

How to Keep Your Stuff Safe

Because claims no longer prevent raiding or roll back griefing, you need to rely on vanilla survival instincts:

  1. Travel far from spawn: Don’t build within sight of (0, 0) or the spawn docks. Head a few thousand blocks out.
  2. Hide your base: Underground vaults, hidden entrances under natural terrain, and off-axis travel keep your base hidden.
  3. Guard your coordinates: Do not stream or share your F3 screen with people you do not trust.

What is Strictly Banned (Zero Tolerance)

Semi-no-rules means freedom inside normal survival gameplay—it does not mean anything goes. The following will get you permanently banned without a warning:

  1. Cheats & Hacked Clients: X-ray texture packs/mods, killaura, fly hacks, speed hacks, freecam, auto-clickers, and botting scripts like Baritone. Play with standard vanilla survival mechanics.
  2. Doxxing, DDoS & Real-Life Drama: Any IP grabbing, threats, harassment, or digging into players’ real-life identities (no calling people’s families, schools, or employers). Keep everything strictly in the game.
  3. Identity Slurs & Severe Abuse: Racial or gender-based slurs, including the n-word, bring an immediate permanent ban. Casual swearing out of frustration is allowed (though in-game warnings may remind you it is discouraged), but slurs are zero tolerance.
  4. Lag Machines: Intentionally building redstone lag machines, entity crammers, or chunk loaders meant to lag or crash the server.
  5. Duping: Item duplication glitches and exploits. Duped items are cleared and offenders are banned.

How to Join

Nothing changes about how you connect:

  • Server Address: fiesta.debarkak.xyz
  • Java Port: 25565 (default)
  • Bedrock Port: 19132 (default)
  • Account Types: Both premium and offline/cracked accounts can join.

When you log in, follow the in-game GUI authentication prompt to secure your username against spam bots.

If you have any questions or want to jump into the discussion, hop into our Discord or read the updated Terms & Rules.

item.title: Season 2 Information & Getting Started
item.dc:creator: debarkak
item.description: How to connect on Java and Bedrock, complete in-game GUI authentication, set custom skins, and start playing on Season 2.
item.content:encoded:
Season 2 is up and running on a fresh map with crossplay between Java and Bedrock, and any account type can join. Here are the basics if you are new to the server.

Joining the Server

You can connect on both Java and Bedrock using the same address:

  • Server IP: fiesta.debarkak.xyz
  • Java Port: 25565 (default)
  • Bedrock Port: 19132 (default)

Both premium and offline/cracked accounts can connect directly without needing special launchers.

Account Authentication (In-Game GUI)

When you join the server for the first time, an in-game GUI prompt will appear on your screen to secure your account name.

We use an interactive GUI menu rather than chat commands like /register or /login. This keeps automated spam bots from flooding the server and skewing player counts. Simply follow the on-screen prompt when you log in.

Setting Your Skin

If your skin appears as a default Steve or Alex:

  • Type /skin <username> to copy the skin of any Java player.
  • Type /skin <directPngUrl> to load a skin directly from an image link.
  • Once set, other players will see your skin in-game and on the website gallery.

Survival & Bases

There is no spawn protection radius on FiestaSMP. The entire map outside the starter docks is open survival with PvP and base raiding enabled. Grab starter food from the public spawn docks, head a few thousand blocks out into the wilderness, hide your chests underground, and build your base away from heavily traveled paths.

Reset Policy

Map resets happen only when the community agrees to a fresh start. We always announce resets at least 45 days in advance so everyone has time to wrap up builds. After any season shuts down, we upload the complete world map archive so anyone can download it and keep their builds forever.

If you have questions or need help, join our Discord or check out the Terms & Rules.

item.title: Spawn Docks & Submitting Screenshots
item.dc:creator: debarkak
item.description: Spawn docks with starter food and boat ramps, plus how to get your base screenshots on the gallery.
item.content:encoded:
We finished setting up the spawn harbor area so new players have a decent starting point when they first join.

What is at Spawn

  • Boat Ramps: Wooden ramps where you can place boats and sail out into the ocean.
  • Starter Crops: Public wheat, carrot, and potato patches for food. Replant what you take so people arriving after you do not starve.
  • Nether Portal: A stairway up to a public Nether portal to make long-distance travel easier.

Keep in mind that there is no spawn protection radius here. Grab what food you need, get away from spawn, and hide your chests once you pick a spot for your base.

Submitting Screenshots for the Gallery

We have an in-game Gallery on the website where we show screenshots of player bases, builds, and world areas.

If you want your base featured on the site:

  1. Press F1 in-game to hide your hotbar and chat.
  2. Take an in-game screenshot.
  3. Post it in #media on our Discord or submit it through our Support Form with your in-game username.
